cohort: 296 women diagnosed with gestational diabetes at SKMCH in Muzaffarpur, Bihar, India
finding: Gestational diabetes was associated with increased prevalence of pregnancy-induced hypertension, caesarean sections, labor induction, macrosomia, premature delivery, perinatal morbidity, and mortality.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rate was 58.8% among women with gestational diabetes.
